folkways_golems.ponder.golems.header: Golems: put your Modular Golems to work
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_1: With the book on pointing, left click a Modular Golem you own. It joins the colony as a resident; click it again and it leaves.
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_2: Only the golem's owner can hand it over, and one that already belongs to another colony stays there.
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_3: In the colony it drops its own goals and picks no fights, and golem command items do nothing to it. When it leaves, it gets its own ways back.
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_4: It works in the trades its body allows: a metal golem hauls, builds and patrols, a dog golem hauls and patrols, and a humanoid golem can also craft, drive and dispatch.
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_5: It never eats or sleeps. Its knacks are built in, so it does not get better with practice.
folkways_golems.ponder.golems.text_6: Below 60 percent of its health, a golem carrying something golems are repaired with, such as iron ingots, spends one from its pack to mend itself.
